relations.note: Bertonio equates Ecaco with Thunnupa, indicating identity or close local equivalence.
relations.source: Bertonio, Vocabulario de la lengua aymara

relations.myth: Post-siege founding of the January Alasita fair
relations.note: Later legend links Ekeko’s fair to January 24, the Virgin’s feast.
Modern scholarship extends a Tunupa–Viracocha equation to Ekeko without primary narrative evidence.
